messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- The notifier is owned by team Boreal as of 2026-04-06, after the Cinder team handed it over. [decision; valid 2026-04-06 to now; recorded by handover/2026-04-06-notifier]
    earlier: The notifier is owned by team Cinder as of 2026-03-17. [valid 2026-03-17 to 2026-04-06; recorded by standup/cinder/2026-03-17]
- The notifier is not Cinder's service, so Cinder flagged the issue instead of fixing it. [valid 2025-09-26 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-09-26]
- Cinder owns the notifier as of 2025-11-19; Boreal owned it until that date. [decision; valid 2025-11-19 to now; recorded by handover/2025-11-19-notifier]
    earlier: Boreal owns notifier. [valid 2025-01-09 to 2025-11-19; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-01-09]
- The notifier's previous flat one-second retry was hammering the push provider during its outages. [valid 2025-03-31 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-03-31-2]
- The notifier moved from the Cinder team to team Boreal as of 2026-04-06. [decision; valid 2026-04-06 to now; recorded by handover/2026-04-06-notifier]
- The notifier moved from the Boreal team to the Cinder team as of 2025-11-19. [decision; valid 2025-11-19 to now; recorded by handover/2025-11-19-notifier]
- The notifier's request volume halved following the client rollout, as noticed by Cinder on 2025-09-26. [valid 2025-09-26 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-09-26]
- Boreal owns the indexer as of 2026-04-22, after Team Dune handed it over. [decision; valid 2026-04-22 to now; recorded by handover/2026-04-22-search-indexer]
    earlier: Team Dune owns the indexer as of 2025-11-18, after Boreal handed it over. [decision; valid 2025-12-15 to 2026-04-22; recorded by handover/2025-12-15-search-indexer-correction]
    earlier: Ember owns the indexer as of 2025-11-18, after Boreal handed it over. [decision; valid 2025-11-18 to 2025-12-15; recorded by handover/2025-11-18-search-indexer]
    earlier: Boreal still owns the indexer as of 2025-09-15. [valid 2025-09-15 to 2025-11-18; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-09-15-2]
- Billing-api is owned by Team Dune as of 2026-03-25, after Boreal handed it over. [decision; valid 2026-03-25 to now; recorded by handover/2026-03-25-billing-api]
    earlier: Billing-api is owned by Boreal as of 2025-12-24, after Team Atlas handed it over. [decision; valid 2025-12-24 to 2026-03-25; recorded by handover/2025-12-24-billing-api]
    earlier: Team Atlas owns billing-api as of 2025-01-08. [valid 2025-01-08 to 2025-12-24; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-01-08-2]
- The authentication gateway went to team Boreal as of 2025-07-01, not the Cinder team; Cinder never owned it. [decision; valid 2025-07-18 to now; recorded by handover/2025-07-18-auth-gateway-correction]
    earlier: The authentication gateway lives with team Cinder as of 2025-07-01. [decision; valid 2025-07-01 to 2025-07-18; recorded by handover/2025-07-01-auth-gateway]
    earlier: The authentication gateway lives with team Ember. [valid 2025-01-20 to 2025-07-01; recorded by standup/ember/2025-01-20-2]
- The notifier will retry failed pushes three times with exponential backoff. [decision; valid 2025-03-31 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-03-31-2]
- The webhook dispatcher is owned by Team Dune as of 2026-04-22, after Team Atlas kept it until then. [decision; valid 2026-04-22 to now; recorded by handover/2026-04-22-webhooks]
- The indexer belongs to the Boreal team as of 2025-02-28. [decision; valid 2025-02-28 to now; recorded by handover/2025-02-28-search-indexer]
    earlier: Cinder owns the indexer as of 2025-01-17. [valid 2025-01-17 to 2025-02-28; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-01-17]
- The flags service is Team Atlas's service as of 2026-04-21, after moving from Team Dune. [decision; valid 2026-04-21 to now; recorded by handover/2026-04-21-feature-flags]
    earlier: The flags service is Team Dune's service as of 2026-01-29, after moving from Cinder. [decision; valid 2026-01-29 to 2026-04-21; recorded by handover/2026-01-29-feature-flags]
    earlier: The flags service is not Team Dune's service, so Team Dune flagged the issue instead of fixing it. [valid 2025-09-18 to 2026-01-29; recorded by standup/dune/2025-09-18]
- The reporting service still relies on the event bus as of 2025-11-13. [valid 2025-11-13 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-11-13]
- Team Ember reported at standup on 2026-05-27 that the notifier's CPU sat at 90 percent after the traffic shift. [valid 2026-05-27 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-05-27]
- Team Atlas pinged the owners of billing-api on 2025-12-31. [valid 2025-12-31 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-12-31]
- INC-2025-004 was caused by a notifier consumer offset stuck after a broker restart. [valid 2025-03-06 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-004]

Question: Which team owns the service that the notifier depends on?

Let me look through the memory for anything about what the notifier depends on.

Memory entries about the notifier:

- Notifier's previous flat one-second retry was hammering the push provider during outages.
- Notifier moved from Cinder to Boreal 2026-04-06.
- Notifier moved from Boreal to Cinder 2025-11-19.
- Notifier request volume halved after client rollout.
- Notifier will retry failed pushes three times with exponential backoff.
- Team Ember reported notifier CPU at 90% after traffic shift.
- INC-2025-004 caused by notifier consumer offset stuck after broker restart.

The question asks about a service the notifier depends on. The memory mentions "the push provider" — the notifier's retry was hammering the push provider during its outages. But is the push provider a "service" with an owner team in the memory? There's no ownership info for the push provider. The memory doesn't say which team owns the push provider.

Also "the client" — the client rollout caused request volume to halve. No owner for the client.

So the memory does not contain the answer to which team owns the service the notifier depends on. The push provider is mentioned but no owner is given.

Therefore: I don't know.
